# Scene tools

10 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `get_scene_tree`

Get the scene tree of the currently edited scene or a specific scene file

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `scene_path` | `string` | — | Path to scene file (e.g. 'res://scenes/Main.tscn'). Omit to use the active scene. |
| `max_depth` | `number` | — | Max tree depth to return (default: unlimited) |
| `max_results` | `integer` | — | Maximum nodes to walk (default 500, negative for no limit). Bounds a wide tree, which max_depth cannot. The response carries truncated: true, and each shortened node truncated_children: true. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/02-scene.json`, test S-01:

```json
{}
```

## `create_scene`

Create and save a new scene with a root node

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | Scene name (also used as root node name) |
| `root_type` | `string` | yes | Root node type, e.g. 'Node2D', 'Node3D', 'Control', 'Node' |
| `path` | `string` | — | Save path, e.g. 'res://scenes/Player.tscn'. Defaults to res://<name>.tscn |
| `open_after_create` | `boolean` | — | Open the scene in the editor after creating (default: true) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/02-scene.json`, test S-02:

```json
{
  "name": "TestRoot",
  "root_type": "Node2D",
  "path": "res://test_scene.tscn"
}
```

## `save_scene`

Save the scene currently open in the editor to disk. Node mutations (add_node, set_node_property, add_mesh, ...) only change the in-memory scene — call this to commit them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `scene_path` | `string` | — | Optional 'save as' path, e.g. 'res://scenes/Main.tscn'. Omit to save over the scene's existing file. Required if the scene has never been saved. Intermediate directories are created automatically. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/02-scene.json`, test S-09d:

```json
{}
```

## `instantiate_scene`

Instantiate a scene as a child node inside the active scene (supports UndoRedo)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `scene_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the scene to instantiate, e.g. 'res://prefabs/Enemy.tscn' |
| `parent_path` | `string` | yes | Node path of the parent in the active scene (e.g. '.' for root) |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the instance. Defaults to scene filename stem. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/02-scene.json`, test S-08c:

```json
{
  "scene_path": "res://test_prefab.tscn",
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "PrefabInstance"
}
```
